text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPM-003","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm."}],"comment":"Note N3 specifies case hardening but no area on the drawing is marked with XXXXX to show where the hardened zone applies, leaving the heat treater without clear boundaries. The designer should add XXXXX hatching or a boundary line on the views to define the case-hardened region.","recommended_correction":"Add XXXXX markings on the drawing views to clearly indicate the areas to be case hardened."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D20","page":1,"quote":"-0.006"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"-0.017"}],"comment":"The ⌀7 locating pin diameter (D4) carries only unilateral numeric limits (-0.006/-0.017 from D20/D21) instead of a standard ISO fit designation such as h6, which is required for a functional locating feature so the mating hole can be properly specified. The designer should replace the numeric limits with an appropriate ISO fit callout (e.g., ⌀7h6).","recommended_correction":"Replace the numeric tolerance on the ⌀7 locating diameter with a standard ISO fit designation appropriate for a locating pin."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D20","page":1,"quote":"-0.006"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"-0.017"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20MnCr5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.08 kg"}],"comment":"The part is zinc plated (I.Z.B.P. per N4) and the ⌀7 locating diameter has a total tolerance band of 0.011 mm (from D20/D21), yet there is no allowance for plating thickness on this tight fit. Without accounting for the coating buildup, the finished pin will be oversized and may not assemble into its mating hole. The designer should shift the pre-plate machining limits to accommodate the specified plating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the dimensional limits of the ⌀7 feature to allow for the zinc plating thickness so the final coated size remains within the required fit envelope."}]}
